channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed overt frustration with the United States in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.

item.title: NPR: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
item.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

item.title: BBC News: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
item.description: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

item.title: The Guardian: Your full attention: Jesse Eisenberg’s 10 best film performances – ranked!
item.description: As his new movie The Debut closes the London film festival, we count down the best of the actor’s shy, sly and sometimes hairy outings A doppelganger role can be a trap for an actor: either the two roles are not sufficie…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Trump says Fort Hood shooter execution will not be livestreamed
item.description: US president reverses Pentagon's plan to publicly stream execution of Nidal Malik Hasan after outcry.

item.title: Ars Technica: Fridge hack costing millions and sparking fires stemmed from poor security
item.description: Incident hitting 700 supermarkets exploited outdated devices exposed to the Internet.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: cool kids are writing in all lowercase now. does that make you mad?
item.description: a certain kind of person writes in all lowercase now. why?

item.title: WIRED Science: Artemis III Scientist Shares What to Expect From NASA’s Next Lunar Mission
item.description: Though scaled back from initial plans of landing, the voyage will serve as a dress rehearsal for when humans return to the moon’s surface.

item.title: WIRED Business: Over $600 Million in Polymarket Election Trades Took Place After Races Ended
item.description: Contracts tied to elections in Ethiopia and Romania saw massive trading volumes after the outcomes were decided. “It’s obviously some form of volume manipulation,” one expert says.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Death of a Young Haitian’s American Dream
item.description: Pierre Damas Bel was a twenty-year-old college student planning for his future. His family says that ICE monitoring made him lose hope.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Hilary Swank Is Expecting Her Third Child
item.description: The actress, who’s 52, previously welcomed twins in 2023.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The 7th Floor–8th Floor Marriage
item.description: His furniture is from Uline. Her taste is more traditional. The couple who splits their lives between two apartments.
